title: Private beta
intro: Decide who can join in each market while the beta is invite-only. Each invite is for clients or for helpers, works a set number of times, and can be withdrawn. People who already joined keep their access.
readOnly: Support leads and admins manage invites, and admins flip the switches. You can see them here.
joinedSummary: {posters, plural, =0 {No clients} one {# client} other {# clients}} and {helpers, plural, =0 {no helpers} one {# helper} other {# helpers}} joined with an invite.

sign_up.title: Invite-only sign-up
sign_up.on: New accounts in {market} need an invite code (for clients or helpers) to finish signing up. Accounts that already signed up aren't affected.
sign_up.off: Anyone in {market} can sign up. Turn this on to make new accounts need an invite.

helpers.title: Invite-only helpers
helpers.on: Becoming a helper in {market} needs a helper invite. Helpers who already started setup keep going.
helpers.off: Anyone with an account in {market} can start helper setup. Turn this on to make it need a helper invite.

poster.title: Clients
poster.hint: Finishes sign-up. Helper setup still needs a helper invite while that switch is on.

helper.title: Helpers
helper.hint: Finishes sign-up and opens helper setup.

form.title: New invite
form.label: Name
form.labelHint: Only staff see this, for example "Mueller neighborhood group" or "Jordan's referrals".
form.maxUsesHint: Each person uses it once. Up to {max}.
form.expiresHint: After that, the code stops working.
form.customCodeHint: 6 to 24 letters and digits, for example MUELLER. Leave it empty for a generated code like K7QP-M4XD.
form.created: Invite created. Copy its link or code to share it.

maxUses.required: Enter how many people can use it.

customCode.invalid: Use only letters, digits and dashes.
customCode.too_short: Use at least 6 letters or digits.
customCode.too_long: Use 24 letters or digits or fewer.
customCode.in_use: That code exists already. Choose another one.

codes.empty: No active invites in this market.
codes.emptyManage: No active invites in this market. Create one above to start letting people in.
codes.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the code and copy it yourself.
codes.revokeBody: Nobody new can use it. People who already joined with it keep their access.
codes.joined: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody joined yet} one {# person joined} other {# people joined}}
codes.nobody: Nobody has used this invite yet.
codes.stillSigningUp: Entered the code {date}, still signing up

switchesAdminOnly: Only admins can flip the invite-only switches.
